title: feat(spec): relatedLists is the record page's tab list, with built-in tabs by object name and per-entry title and columns
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu8asiBATVNp4pogcic92dHU)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTgsPwrw3VbvRRcqth

Fixes #35897
Fixes #35899

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: follow-up #35902 (skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md)

## 维护者速读

- 对象声明了 `relatedLists`，详情页的标签页就只显示列出的相关列表，按列出的顺序；没列的不再显示。没声明（或为空）时完全不变。
- 三个内置标签用对象名放置：`sys_attachment`（附件）、`sys_approval_request`（审批）、`sys_activity`（活动流）；附件不列就不显示，审批和活动流不列时仍排在末尾。
- 每一项可写 `{ list, label, columns }` 给该列表自己的标题和列；列名不是子对象字段会被 `os validate`、`os build` 和元数据写入口拒绝。
- 字段分组放进概览的主从明细表（#35889）：没声明 `relatedLists` 时既在概览里、也保留页签；声明了但没列它，就只在概览里，不出页签（席位裁定 7048340194）。
- Studio 对象设置里可以排页签、加内置标签、给每一项改标题和列；保存时保留对象写法和内置名。对象没开文件时，附件不出现在可选项里，已列的附件会提示不会显示。
- 风险：已经声明了部分 `relatedLists` 的应用，没列的标签会消失（仓库内无此类对象；已部署的元数据未测量）。

## What changes

An object's declared `relatedLists` becomes its record page's tab list (epic #35896):

```ts
relatedLists: [
  { list: 'quote_line', label: 'Line items', columns: ['product', 'quantity', 'unit_price', 'amount'] },
  'task',
  'sys_attachment',
  'sys_approval_request',
  'sys_activity',
],
```

- **spec** (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`, new `related-list-entry.ts`): an entry is the bare name or `{ list, label?, columns? }` (strict, with aliases and guidance). The three built-in tabs are named by object: `sys_attachment`, `sys_approval_request`, `sys_activity`. A built-in is written only as its bare name; the object form naming one is refused at parse (a regex, so the published JSON schema keeps the refinement). `defineStack`'s name check skips built-ins. The shared helpers `RECORD_PAGE_BUILTIN_TABS`, `isRecordPageBuiltinTab`, `relatedListEntryName` and `RELATED_LIST_BUILTIN_PART_OF` are the one reading of an entry's name for every reader.
- **lint** (`validate-related-list-refs`): new `related-list-column-unknown` (error: a column that is no field of the child, registry-injected columns included), `related-list-attachments-off` (warning: `sys_attachment` on an object without `enable.files`) and `related-list-stream-part` (warning: `sys_comment` / `sys_audit_log` are parts of the stream; prescribes `sys_activity`). The same rule runs at `os validate`, `os build` and the metadata write door.
- **record page** (objectui):
  - `deriveRelatedLists`: on a declared non-empty `relatedLists`, an unlisted side list shows no tab. Body tables a field group places are kept, and `relatedList: false` on the FK still hides a list. An entry's `label` / `columns` win over the FK's `relatedListTitle` / `relatedListColumns`.
  - `buildDefaultPageSchema` (`arrangeDeclaredTabs`): tabs follow the declared order. An unlisted attachments tab is dropped. Unlisted approvals follow the listed tabs. An unlisted stream closes the strip. The overview stays first.
  - `recordPageColumns`: the related column keeps that one order.
  - With #35921 merged: a `master_detail` table that a field group places in the overview keeps its tab only while `relatedLists` is undeclared or lists it. A declared `relatedLists` that leaves it out shows it in the overview with no tab (seat ruling 7048340194 on #35897). #35921's ADR-0035 note, changeset and `semantic/18` acceptance text are qualified to say so.
- **Studio** (`RelatedListsEditor`, `relatedListVocabulary.acceptTabListEntries`): the object settings panel edits `relatedLists` as the tab list. Object entries and built-in names survive every move, removal and add. The add picker offers the built-ins by name (attachments only when `enable.files` is on), then the unlisted relationships. A relationship row edits its own title and columns; clearing both writes the bare name again. A listed attachments tab on an object without files shows a notice. The preview draws the tabs in order, built-ins included. New strings in `@object-ui/i18n` (en, zh).
- **FLS mask** (`object-schema-fls-references.ts`): `relatedLists` entries stay unmasked like `lookupColumns`: the columns are the child's fields, the label is author text, and the built-ins are object names. A pin test covers an entry whose column shares a denied field's name.
- **migration**: ADR-0087 semantic entry `related-lists-declared-is-tab-list`. No D2 conversion, because which unlisted lists an author still wants is recorded nowhere.
- **ADR notes**:
  - ADR-0085 gets a dated note: §2's hide/re-arrange guard yields for `relatedLists` only, per the maintainer's ruling.
  - ADR-0035 gets a dated amendment.
  - Both were drafted at the opus tier under the quota exemption.
- Generated references, the API surface, liveness children (`list`, `label`, `columns`) and the strictness ledger counts are regenerated.

**Tier H**: this PR touches `docs/adr/**`.

## Why

The maintainer ruled that the record page's tabs are declared on the parent object in one place: removing an entry removes its tab, `relatedLists` is that list, and the three built-in tabs are named by their objects. Before this change, a declared `relatedLists` only ordered the lists: every unlisted list still followed, and the built-ins always closed the strip in a fixed order.

## Tests

- spec: `stack-related-lists-order.test.ts` (object entries, built-ins, the parse refusal, `defineStack`); new `related-list-entry.test.ts`.
- lint: `validate-related-list-refs.test.ts` (built-ins, both warnings, unknown and injected columns); `rule-explanations` covers the three new ids.
- metadata-core: `object-schema-fls-references.test.ts` (#35899 entry pin).
- Studio: new `ObjectSettingsPanel.relatedListsTabList-35897.test.tsx` (5 tests); `ObjectSettingsPanel.relatedListsOrder-27054.test.tsx` expects the built-in add options.
- ui: `buildDefaultPageSchema.test.ts`, new describe `declared relatedLists arranges the tabs (objectstack#35897)`; `deriveRelatedLists.relatedListsOrder-27069.test.ts`. Three tests that pinned the old "unlisted lists follow" meaning now pin the new one: two in the 27069 file, the 27241 case in `RecordDetailView.harness.test.tsx` (with a new all-listed control), and the page-order expectations in `ObjectSettingsPanel.relatedListsOrder-27054.test.tsx`. The 27069 file also pins the ruling: a group-placed `master_detail` table keeps its tab when `relatedLists` is undeclared or lists it, and loses only the tab when unlisted.

## Acceptance notes

On the record page of each object that declares `relatedLists`, the tabs after the overview are the listed related lists and built-in tabs, in the listed order. Then come approvals, if unlisted and the record has requests, and the activity stream last. An object that declares no `relatedLists` shows the same tabs as before. In-repo census: no example, platform object, dogfood fixture or HotCRM object declares `relatedLists` today.

## Verification

On the final head 473c7ff4 (main with #35921 merged, then the ruling fix, then regeneration): `@objectstack/spec` test 2355 files passed, `check:test-typecheck` and `check:generated` clean; `@objectstack/lint` 868 files passed; `@objectstack/metadata-core` 222 files passed; `@object-ui/plugin-detail` 105 files passed; `@object-ui/app-shell` 394 files passed; `@object-ui/i18n` 27 files passed. `@objectstack/cli` was cut off by the local time limit and is left to CI. Earlier runs, before the merge:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` on the touched files; `check:generated`; `check:liveness`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test` (validate-related-list-refs, runtime-gate, rule-explanations).
- ui vitest (from `ui/`) on the touched plugin-detail / app-shell files: 7 files, 227 passed. A wide app-shell + plugin-detail run had no other failures.
- Typecheck: spec, lint, plugin-detail and app-shell `type-check`.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived list (128 commands) run locally: 126 green (two of them after building their inputs). Two are prerequisite refusals that measure nothing here, left to CI: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (needs a full clone), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs a whole-repo build). An ADR-0122 alias finding was fixed in da074fdd.

## Human Minimum

Each item is one rule from
[CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum),
which links the AGENTS.md text that states it.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (The new `related-list-entry.ts` holds only the name constants and two pure name readers, like `related-list-body-table.ts`.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (ESLint on every changed file: 0 errors.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. (Two cards folded by the dispatch order, one `Fixes` line each.)
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (Except the maintainer's 维护者速读 block.)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.

Tier H (`docs/adr/**`): the ADR-0085 and ADR-0035 notes need the approver's review.
